protocol.description: Five matching hidden, idle tabs. One browser at a time holds the test pages. Chrome uses a fresh isolated profile; Notch uses its existing profile. Personal Chrome processes are excluded from browser CPU totals. CPU percentages are relative to one core. Both browser hosts and other applications remain running.

limitations: Other apps remained running and contribute to chip power.
Notch Debug build and existing profile versus Chrome fresh profile.
Only hidden, idle pages were measured; no active-browsing claim.
Process CPU attribution uses observed process identities. Exited tasks between identity snapshots can be missed; this is exploratory, not a validated marketing CPU claim.
